import re
from datetime import datetime
from dateutil import parser


def extract(text: str) -> dict:
    if not re.search(r'^From:\s*Apollo Clinic\b', text, re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE):
        raise ValueError('Missing From label')

    person_match = re.search(
        r'Appointment\s+confirmed\s+for\s+(.+?)\s+with\s+Dr\.',
        text,
        re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
    )
    if not person_match:
        raise ValueError('Missing appointment person label')
    person = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', person_match.group(1)).strip()

    date_match = re.search(r'^Date:\s*(.+)$', text, re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
    if not date_match:
        raise ValueError('Missing Date label')
    due_date = parser.parse(date_match.group(1).strip(), dayfirst=True).date().isoformat()

    time_match = re.search(r'^Time:\s*(.+)$', text, re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
    if not time_match:
        raise ValueError('Missing Time label')
    event_time = parser.parse(time_match.group(1).strip()).strftime('%H:%M')

    return {
        'type': 'meeting',
        'provider': 'Apollo Clinic',
        'currency': 'INR',
        'due_date': due_date,
        'event_time': event_time,
        'person': person,
    }
data.notes: Anchors on Apollo Clinic appointment labels to extract patient name, appointment date, and time deterministically.
